title: IntelOwl
description: The IntelOwl internal-enrichment connector runs an IntelOwl playbook (FREE_TO_USE_ANALYZERS by default) on IPv4/IPv6 addresses, domains, hostnames, URLs and file hashes, waits for the job to finish, and writes the results back to OpenCTI: a Note on the observable with IntelOwl's aggregated verdict, reliability, tags and the status of every analyzer, linked to the job in IntelOwl; the observable's score from the verdict and IntelOwl's tags as labels (both optional); and a Malware entity with a related-to relationship when IntelOwl names a malware family. The observable's TLP is passed to IntelOwl so it only runs analyzers allowed for that TLP. IntelOwl is open source and self-hosted.
short_description: Enrich IPs, domains, hostnames, URLs and file hashes by running an IntelOwl playbook: verdict note, score, labels and malware family.
